name: Coldseam Disgraced Spire Judge's Exit Coat Set
description:
A Tier 5 judicial robe, stripped of its corponation insignia and re-hemmed by hand — the ghost-stitching where the rank panels were removed is visible if you look. Beneath it: a charcoal collarless shirt in worn silk-analog, tucked into high-waisted formal trousers with a faint grey plaid that once cost more than a Circuit worker's annual wage. Shoes are bespoke Spire-era wholecuts, resoled twice with Shelf-grade rubber. Everything is immaculate but faded.

A single unadorned neural port at the temple — the BCI housing is the expensive kind, but the port cap is scratched. Old money. No power.
materials: stripped judicial robe fabric (silk-poly ceremonial blend)
functionality: Provides social camouflage across multiple tiers — reads as high-status to Shelf and Circuit, reads as fallen to Tier 4+. Robe functions as weatherproofing. Resoled shoes provide grip on wet Shelf pavement. Neural port housing accepts standard BCI modules.
what_it_says: You used to matter in rooms where it counted, and you are very carefully not saying what happened to change that.
worn_by: Tier 5 fugitives hiding in plain sight
price_range: Φ 40 – Φ 120 (current resale; original pieces worth Φ 8,000+)
story_hooks: The ghost-stitching pattern of the removed insignia is recognizable to anyone who knows Corponation Aurelius House heraldry — this person adjudicated something that was never made public.
The judge still has one active legal credential buried in their BCI — it's been dormant for two years and they haven't decided whether to use it.
Someone in the Shelf keeps leaving food outside this person's door. They've never asked why.
